zombietide.warning.title: Night Tide
zombietide.warning.subtitle: They remember every door
zombietide.sleep.blocked: The bedframe creaked. Something outside creaked back.
zombietide.morning.1: Morning came. The village is still here. Fewer people are.
zombietide.morning.2: The sun rose as usual. The shadows are longer than yesterday.
zombietide.morning.3: The rooster crowed once. There was no second crow.
zombietide.morning.4: There is a sound in the well. Like someone counting below.
zombietide.morning.5: The wind stopped. The footsteps did not.
zombietide.morning.6: The door is shut. It is very quiet behind it.
zombietide.morning.7: The chimney is cold. So is the stove.
zombietide.morning.8: The tracks circle once and return to where they began.
zombietide.morning.9: The door was nailed shut. The nails went in from inside.
zombietide.morning.11: The dog stopped barking. It was barking yesterday.
zombietide.morning.12: The water barrel is full. There is dust on the surface.
zombietide.morning.13: Stones on the roof. The one who placed them is gone.
zombietide.morning.14: The clock stopped at the same hour.
zombietide.morning.15: The mirror is covered with cloth.
zombietide.morning.16: Cloth in the door gap. The cloth is damp.
zombietide.morning.17: A new mark on the wall. It was not there yesterday.
zombietide.morning.18: The granary is empty. The door is open.
zombietide.morning.19: The bell is ringing. No one touched it.
zombietide.morning.20: The fog lifted. What stood in it did not.
zombietide.morning.21: They do not run. They know the way.
zombietide.morning.22: They have learned to knock. Three times. A pause.
zombietide.morning.26: Count them. There is always one more.
zombietide.morning.27: Someone sharpened a blade in the night. The one sharpening it had no shadow.
zombietide.morning.28: The bedframe creaked. Something outside creaked back.
zombietide.morning.29: The lamp went out. Something moved in the dark.
zombietide.morning.30: One more shadow on the wall. One person in the room.
zombietide.morning.31: The bolt is new. The door is old.
zombietide.morning.32: They wait for dark. After dark, they stop waiting.
zombietide.morning.33: The cellar is full. The one who filled it is not here.
zombietide.morning.34: Too much dinner. One fewer came to eat.
zombietide.morning.35: A hole in the window paper. Poked from outside.
zombietide.morning.36: The children no longer go out. The adults do not either.
zombietide.morning.37: Footsteps on the roof. No one on the roof.
zombietide.morning.38: They come from the north. The northern woods are empty.
zombietide.morning.39: They do not call out. They stand.
zombietide.morning.40: At dawn they scatter. At dusk they return.
zombietide.ambush.1: They did not wait for dark.
zombietide.ambush.2: The footsteps outside stopped. Then started again.
zombietide.ambush.3: One more shadow. One person in the room.
zombietide.ambush.4: The wind brought the smell. Too late.
zombietide.ambush.5: Something stands in the dark. It has stood there a long time.
zombietide.ambush.6: The torch flickered. The shadow did not.
zombietide.ambush.7: They came from the same direction.
zombietide.ambush.8: A branch broke. The sound carried far.
zombietide.ambush.9: Something is scratching behind the door.
zombietide.ambush.10: Footsteps behind. No one turns around.
zombietide.ambush.11: They have been following. Now they let themselves be heard.
zombietide.ambush.12: Something shifted in the dark. Then it went quiet.
